text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby is a few days away
and
Sakura Chiyono O has been working
hard, driven
by her intense passion for
the race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Peel as you might, the layers of an
onion are
limitless"! I still have so many
things I have to do!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But if I stay on this path and don't stray
from it,
I'm sure I'll be able to catch up
to Maruzen one
day!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On another day...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: T-T-Trainer! Listen to this, listen to this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen invited me to run in a
scrimmage against
her!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
H-huh?! Oh, it's this weekend! Wait, why
are you
so enthusiastic about it?
choice_data_list: そうか！いつになりそうだ？
そうなんだ！いつになりそう？

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So when... when that happens, when I'm

stronger... Will you run with me again?
choice_data_list: だって君の目標だっただろう？
だって貴方の目標だったよね？

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Haha! Of course!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. It's always been my dream.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She's always been the one I want to
become, the
one I admire, the one I
want to stand side-by-side
with...
because she's my rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From that day on, Sakura Chiyono O
begins to
research how to beat
Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes is a good
place to
start when it comes to analyzing
Maruzen's races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Just look at her speed and incredible
race sense.
And that delighted smile she
has on when she's...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh? But...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (Why does Maruzen's running look—)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, we hear a frustrated scream
echo
through the halls.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The source of the commotion is Sweep
Tosho, a
racer who dreams of becoming
a witch like her
grandmother, and Mr.
C.B., a Triple Crown
champion.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I already told you! Grandma said there's
no
medicine like that!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Then let me speak directly to this
grandmother of
yours. Not because I
doubt you, of course. I truly
believe in
her abilities. That's why I want to talk.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, too bad! She's my grandma, not
yours!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...That went poorly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, C.B.?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If you're here to scold me for all the
noise, there's
no need. I'm already done
with my business... Oh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O? You're running with
Maruzen
this weekend, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Tell me something... do you have to race her now? Can't you delay that race for a later time, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I just... can't accept this. I miss the Hot
Rod and
have been waiting for her to
shift into gear once
again.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And I'm telling you this now, Chiyono O.
Your
wish will never come true.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Are you saying that I'll never be able
to beat
Maruzen?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I mean. There is
something
even more important to you
and Maruzen than
that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You want to be like Maruzensky, don't
you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
But does that mean you want to replace
her?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
N-no! Maruzen is Maruzen! No one can
replace
her!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, if that's the case, I wouldn't
continue down
this path you're going
down. You'll live to regret
it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen will never be your rival. She'll
just leave
you in the dust—abandon you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Along with all her personal baggage.
You sure
you want that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um... Sorry, I don't really understand
what you're
saying...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No, I think you do. Surely you've noticed
that
far-off look in the Beast's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Mr. Trainer. This is something only
racers
can comprehend. Just like there
are some things
only our supporters can
understand.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Ms. Trainer. This is something only
racers
can comprehend. Just like there
are some things
only our supporters can
understand.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The answer isn't something you can
search for,
either. If she doesn't have an
answer right now,
then she never will.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, the day of Sakura Chiyono O
and
Maruzensky's scrimmage arrives.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Chiyo, great job at the Derby! You've
improved
sooo much!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, then! Let's race! This'll be a
Derby for
just you and me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(And now, my long-awaited scrimmage
with
Maruzen begins...)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Time to burn some rubber!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(The Hot Rod is right in front of me, her

incredible legs going so fast, they look
like
they're slicing the air into pieces.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...She's fast. But today, I—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Remember the Derby. Remember how it
felt to
race against your rivals, to run
with all the
strength you have!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Feel their intense determination on
your skin,
and—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Keep running and running until you
overtake me.
If you can make it, then I'll
give you one last
present...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So go on and fly past me, Chiyo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Oh... I think I know what C.B. was saying
now.)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Chiyo?! What's wrong? Do your legs
hurt?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. Maruzen...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew. Thank goodness. I was worried
you'd
gotten injured. But goodness, why
did you stop
right in the middle of a
race?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen, you...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You're not afraid of losing to me at all,
are you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Chiyo?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've studied all of your races. I rewatched
all of
them to prepare for this
scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And I realized something while looking
over them.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling you've never felt
desperate in a
race. You've never been
afraid to lose.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen... It's amazing how your life
changes
when you have rivals. You can
work and run
harder than you ever
thought possible.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My rivals are the reason I've been able
to become
this strong. They make me
race with everything I
have.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen, what am I to you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, you're... You're my cute little
underclassman
who looks up to me...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I've wanted to be like you since
forever
ago. But it's more than just
wanting to be like
you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to become as strong and special
an
Umamusume as you are...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And I want to be your rival!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Chiyo...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But there's no fire in your heart. It's like
you've
already given up. Like losing here
is exactly the
outcome you're looking
for.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well, that's—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. I'll just have to work hard until I
become
someone worthy of challenging
you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Until I become worthy of being your
rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I reach that point and you still don't
feel scared
of losing to me, then I'll
simply work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll force you to push yourself harder
than ever
just to keep up with me. I'll
fire up the engines
you've never used
before.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say that, it's too late. I've
already—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I don't want things to end like this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I... I know how fantastic it is to run with
your
whole soul and being, and I want
you to run for
real too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Please watch me, Maruzen. But don't watch me grow, watch me run.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky, I swear that I, Sakura
Chiyono O,
will become your rival!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Chiyo...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have a favor to ask you for our
next
goal race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to run against only
classic-year
racers. I want to run in the
autumn Tenno Sho and
pit my speed
against senior racers too.
choice_data_list: ……君はこの次にどうしたいんだ？
……貴方はこの次にどうしたい？

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's where I'll light that fire in
Maruzen's heart.
